currentClientCharacter.y: 袁谭，大将军袁绍长子，曾任青州刺史。袁绍去世后，审配等伪立遗令，拥立袁尚为继承人，袁谭不能继位，心怀愤恨。后袁谭、袁尚二人的矛盾彻底爆发，袁谭联合曹操共同攻打袁尚。建安十年，曹操兴兵进攻南皮，袁谭奋力抵抗，终于在曹操急攻之下战败，被曹洪所杀。袁尚，袁绍的第三子，受到袁绍的偏爱，并于袁绍去世后继承了袁绍的官位和爵位，也因此招致长兄袁谭的怨恨，兄弟之间经常兵戈相向。后袁氏兄弟均被曹操所败，袁尚与二兄袁熙逃往辽西投奔乌丸首领蹋顿，但不久曹操即平定乌丸，二人只得又投奔辽东太守公孙康，却被公孙康所斩，首级也被送往曹操之处。

printedSpells.o:
出牌阶段开始时，你可以摸两张牌或获得场上一张牌，然后弃置一张牌。若弃置的牌是：
•基本牌，你本回合不能使用锦囊牌和装备牌且【杀】的使用次数+X且目标+1；
•非基本牌，你本回合不能使用基本牌，使用普通锦囊牌的目标可+1或-1（含【借刀】），前两次使用装备牌时摸X张牌（X为手牌中因本技能不能使用的牌且至多为5）。

implementationInterpretations: Uses current exact client904 including optional +1/-1 ordinary-trick targets and full BorrowedSword pairs; old page wording is retained as a version conflict.
Field means living players equipment/judgment, excluding hands/private piles; self-owned legal field entity may be obtained.

After all native gain/recovery/movement children, autonomous legal HE discard pays the branch by printed discarded category. Issued mandatory continuation survives source loss; death drains paid children without new arming.

X is dynamic count of current printed-category hand cards forbidden by that branch, cap5; conversions are prohibited/counted by effective use category. Each actual equipment payment freezes its draw X. No verified official FAQ establishes this algorithm.

Same actual turn rearming unions prohibitions, grants each branch benefit once, and preserves the shared first-two-equipment-use counter. Additional Play does not erase negatives or stack same benefits.
Actual ordinary Response such as Duel/Barbarian Slash is not Use. Genuine Dodge versus Slash and Nullification are Uses for prohibitions.
BorrowedSword authoritative complete ordered Action.TargetSeats pairs are adjusted together. Implicit DrawTwo self and group-trick original targets are eligible for one optional add/remove.
